definitions.explanation: A small community in a rural area.

examples.japanese: {村|むら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{村|むら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}かだ→静か：00755_shizuka⟧。

examples.english: There was a small village deep in the mountains.

notes:
{村|むら} means village - a small rural community. It is also the smallest administrative unit in Japan.

PRONUNCIATION:
- むら: standalone word, native compounds
- そん: in official/formal compound names

ADMINISTRATIVE HIERARCHY:
- {村|むら}: village (smallest)
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: town
- ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧: city
- ⟦{区|く}→区：noentry⟧: ward (in large cities)
- ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧: prefecture

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{村人|むらびと}→村人：13062_murabito⟧: villager
- ⟦{村長|そんちょう}→村長：13091_sonchou⟧: village mayor/chief
- ⟦{農村|のうそん}→農村：04292_nouson⟧: farming village
- ⟦{漁村|ぎょそん}→漁村：noentry⟧: fishing village
- ⟦{村落|そんらく}→村落：27102_sonraku⟧: village, hamlet

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{村八分|むらはちぶ}→村八分：noentry⟧: social ostracism (historical village punishment)
